about: G6 dated exceptions: purchases whose P7 (and P7C) is FORCED to post on or after gl.ledger_start_date. APPEND-ONLY: add a new entry with the next seq; never edit or remove an entry. Once an entry has been applied, the backfill refuses to run if it is changed or missing (gl_forced_post_list_not_append_only). Post date = max(gl.ledger_start_date, day after gl.opening_base_date, Tehran date of the purchase's first payment order). Refused if any payment order of the purchase is already in the opening 2101.
